prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Atlanta for a dental implant?
ai_overview_text:
There is no single "best" dentist for dental implants in Atlanta, as the ideal provider depends on whether you need a single-tooth replacement, full-mouth restoration, or specialized bone grafting. Several top-rated practices and specialists in the Atlanta metro area stand out for implant dentistry based on patient satisfaction, reviews, and clinical focus: Atlanta Center for Advanced Periodontics +1
Lead Provider: Dr. Brett Langston, DMD (along with Dr. Rachel Miro and Dr. Mitchel House)
Specialty: Full-service prosthodontics and restorative dentistry operating since 1972.
Rating: 5/5 stars (565+ reviews)
Highlights: Known for complex, custom restorative and single-tooth cases, natural-looking aesthetics, and a team approach to patient comfort.
Prosthodontist vs. Oral Surgeon vs. Periodontist: Implant placement typically involves two phases—the surgical root placement (handled by an oral surgeon or periodontist) and the crown/tooth restoration (handled by a prosthodontist or general dentist). Some offices house all specialists under one roof. Goldstein Dental Center +1
Cost & Transparency: Single-tooth implants in the Atlanta area generally range from $5,000 to $6,000 total (including the implant post, abutment, and crown), whereas full-arch or All-on-4 solutions range from $19,500 to $40,000+ per arch depending on materials (Zirconia vs. Titanium). ATL Dental Implants +2
Consultation & CT Scans: Look for offices that utilize 3D cone-beam CT (CBCT) imaging for safe, computer-guided placement. Oral Surgery Associates & Dental Implant Centers +1
Are you looking to replace a single tooth or multiple teeth/full arch?
Do you have a preferred side of town (e.g., Buckhead, Midtown, Dunwoody, Marietta)?
